title: Existence of Cech comparison data
statement: For any scheme X, family U of opens with supremum top, and arbitrary module sheaves F,G [def-sc-module-cup-resolution-data], there exists a computing sectionwise resolution pairing D together with CupCechResolutionComparison U data [def-sc-cech-cup-resolution-comparison-data] for its left, right and target resolutions. Each comparison has the specified restriction alpha and augmentation beta components, alpha a quasi-isomorphism, and an isomorphism from module cohomology to total homology identifying both global resolution classes and every canonical Cech comparison [def-sc-module-cech-comparison]. No quasi-coherence or degree hypothesis is imposed.

proof.text: Use moduleCup_godement_pairing to obtain nonnegative flasque resolutions and their augmentation-preserving pairing. Restrict to natural degrees as in the proof of exists_moduleCupResolutionPairing. Compare to injective resolutions over the augmentations; flasque global acyclicity and the acyclic-resolution comparison criterion give the computes fields. Retain the flasque terms when assembling D; existence of an arbitrary CupResolutionPairing alone does not assert these terms are flasque.

Define alpha by restrictions and beta by augmentation. Their cochain identities are the same restriction and augmentation identities used for moduleCechAlpha and moduleCechBeta. Flasque Cech acyclicity and first-quadrant comparison make alpha a quasi-isomorphism. Compose the inverse computing identification with H(alpha) to obtain iso. For the resolution comparison to D.I, its Cech total map commutes with alpha and beta. Its homology map is invertible because both alpha maps and the global comparison are. Use IsModuleCechComparison at D.I and cancel this map to obtain beta_class; alpha_class follows directly from the definition of iso.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_cupCechResolutionComparison (X : Scheme.{v}) {ι : Type v}
    (U : ι → X.Opens) (hU : iSup U = ⊤) (F G : X.Modules) :
    ∃ D : CupResolutionPairing F G,
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.left) ∧
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.right) ∧
      Nonempty (CupCechResolutionComparison U D.target)
